facts_claimed: UPI transactions can show as 'success' even if the receiver hasn't received funds.

If the issue persists, wait for 48 hours for an automatic refund.

Banks have 30 days to resolve payment complaints.
If the bank fails to resolve it, users can contact the RBI.
